title: Single hieratic sign, Kairo, Ägyptisches Museum, JE 58063 (AKU HT 21141)

source.attribution: Georg Möller, Hieratische Paläographie, retro-digitised by AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 21141

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 21141; AKU grapheme X0010 (AKU GR 728). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: X1 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 575. Source publication of this facsimile: Möller 1927a, p. 55, no. 575. Occurrence: find place Pyramidenkomplex des Neferirkare Kakai; writing direction "unspezifiziert"; sign size 1.8 x 5.3 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Altes Reich, 5. Dynastie, Neferirkare I.". Facsimile type: Retro-Digitalisat (Publikation), by Georg Möller. Source scan (WEBP) converted to PNG at native resolution, flattened onto white, white margin added.
